trans-unit.source: Hold the close button or Esc + Return for 2 seconds to unlock
trans-unit.target: আনলক করতে ক্রস বোতাম বা Esc + Return 2 সেকেন্ড চেপে ধরে রাখুন
trans-unit.note: Full-screen overlay hint explaining the hold-to-unlock gesture: either the close button, or holding Esc and Return together. Spells out 'close button' in words rather than using the ✕ glyph inline: next to a number ('✕ 2 seconds') the glyph would read as a multiplication sign. 'Esc' and 'Return' must be Apple's own localized names for those keys in this language (as printed in macOS's keyboard-shortcut notation and documentation, e.g. French 'Échap' and 'Retour'), joined with '+' exactly as here. Never use ✕ or × anywhere in this string.

trans-unit.source: To unlock, hold the close button or Esc + Return for 2 seconds
trans-unit.target: আনলক করতে, ক্রস বোতাম বা Esc + Return 2 সেকেন্ড চেপে ধরে রাখুন
trans-unit.note: Countdown screen's explanation of the hold-to-unlock gesture, shown while the countdown to locking is still running: either the close button, or holding Esc and Return together. Same wording constraints as overlay.hint.hold_to_unlock: spell out the button, use Apple's own localized key names for Esc/Return joined with '+', never use ✕ or ×.
Keyboard-only mode HUD: compact pill shown while the keyboard is locked. Keep this very short, it renders in a small rounded pill.
